title: This Moth Never Eats and Its Wings Look Like Snakes

scenes.text: This moth lives one to two weeks and never eats a single meal.
Its wingspan reaches about 27 centimeters, wider than a dinner plate.
The tips of its wings look like the head of a deadly cobra.
When threatened, it drops to the ground and moves its wings like a snake.
So how does it live without eating? As an adult its mouthparts don't work.
All its food came as a caterpillar up to twelve centimeters long.

subject: atlas moth
description:
The atlas moth lives only one to two weeks and never eats as an adult.
Its wingtips look like cobra heads, and it wiggles them to scare predators.
Would you have guessed a moth could mimic a snake?
